puzzle.q: Two ropes each burn in exactly 60 minutes, but unevenly. Measure 45 minutes.
puzzle.a: Light rope A at both ends and rope B at one end. A dies at 30:00; at that instant light B's other end — its remaining 30 minutes halve to 15. Total: 45.
